title: Release-Aware Adaptive Calibration Under Delayed Feedback: Prediction-Interval Efficiency and Conditional Coverage Across Volatility Regimes — Reproducible Research Code and Simulation Results
description: Versioned research software and archived numerical outputs for the RAAC synthetic prediction-interval calibration benchmark. Includes frozen R simulator source, simulation configuration and prespecified seeds, seven-method benchmark summaries over four volatility scenarios (200 replications each; 800 total), reproducible statistical analysis, and author-executed 800/800 numerical reproduction evidence. The manuscript and rendered figures are excluded. External third-party replication has not been completed.
